name: Deputy
description: Deputy is workforce-management software for shift-based businesses. Teams use it for employee scheduling, time and attendance, shift communication, availability and leave, tasks, labor forecasting, compliance, timesheets, and payroll workflows.
agentUseSummary: Connect Deputy once, then let agents use every selected active operation in Deputy's official Public API under Safe or Dangerous policy.

capabilities.label: Read Deputy
capabilities.description: Use every selected documented retrieval operation for workforce, scheduling, time, attendance, leave, tasks, communication, and account data.

capabilities.label: Manage Deputy
capabilities.description: Use every selected documented public mutation for workforce, scheduling, time, attendance, leave, tasks, communication, and administration.

allowed.label: Read Deputy
allowed.description: Run one exact selected Deputy GET operation from the pinned official documentation.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Deputy
approvalRequired.description: Run one exact selected Deputy mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded Deputy reads run directly; every mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All selected and Deputy-authorized public operations run without Relay per-action approval; connection ownership, fixed install authority, exact routes, bounds, audits, redaction, provider limits, and account authority still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts the selected pinned Deputy operations through the authenticated server-side connector.
Railway mounts the selected pinned Deputy operations through the authenticated server-side connector.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's Deputy OAuth client, exact production callback, Railway client credentials, and live customer-install authorization are not configured.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create Relay Console's Deputy OAuth client at once.deputy.com, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/deputy/callback, store DEPUTY_CLIENT_ID and DEPUTY_CLIENT_SECRET on Railway, then verify authorization, install binding, 24-hour access-token renewal with refresh-token rotation, identity, bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous mutations, local disconnect, provider revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Deputy documents self-service public OAuth client registration, authorization-code exchange, the longlife_refresh_token scope, 24-hour access tokens, rotating refresh tokens, and an install-specific endpoint returned by the token service.

Deputy describes its public API as the same read/write API used by its own applications and states that public apps use OAuth 2.0, while the Advanced Employee API requires a separate vendor security check.
Deputy documents customer-specific install origins, JSON REST APIs, a 500-record response maximum, v1 and v2 routes, trial sandboxes, and ordinary API access for integrations.

Deputy's official machine-readable index enumerates the API reference pages whose per-operation OpenAPI definitions are pinned by Relay; privileged provisioning and HR-onboarding surfaces are excluded.
